translations.1: And if a slain man be found in the land which God your Lord is giving you to take possession of, lying in the open country, and it is not known who killed him —
translations.2: then some of your elders and your judges shall go out and measure toward the towns that are around the slain man,
translations.3: and whichever town is nearest to him, the people of that town shall take a heifer from the cattle, one that has not been worked and has not drawn a yoke,
translations.4: and they shall bring it down to a rugged valley that has neither been tilled nor sown, and shall break its neck there.
translations.5: Then some of the imāms, the sons of Levi, shall come forward — for God your Lord has chosen them to serve Him and to bestow blessing in His name, and by their word shall every dispute and every affliction be decided.
translations.6: And when all the elders of that town nearest to the slain man have washed their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley,
translations.7: they shall begin and say: 'Our hands did not shed this blood, and our eyes did not see that.'
translations.8: And they shall respond to them and say: 'O God, forgive Your people, the house of Israel, whom You redeemed; and do not place upon them the punishment of negligence in the blood of one innocent of guilt' — and so they shall be forgiven for what they were negligent in concerning that blood.
translations.9: And you — banish the killer of the innocent from your midst, for you are doing what is right before God.
translations.10: And when you go out to war against your enemies, and God your Lord delivers them into your hand, and you take captives —
translations.11: and you see among the captives a woman fair of appearance, and your heart is captivated by her, and you take her for yourself as a wife —
translations.12: it shall be by your bringing her into your home, and she shall shave her head and let her nails grow,
translations.13: and she shall remove her captive's garments from upon her, and shall remain thus in your home and weep for the departure of her father and her mother a full month; and after that you shall go in to her and be wed to her, and she shall be your wife.
translations.14: And if you do not desire her after that, then release her free for herself; you shall not sell her for a price — you shall not enslave her — after you have been intimate with her.
translations.15: And if a man has two wives, one beloved and the other disfavored, and both have borne him sons — the beloved and the disfavored — and the firstborn son belongs to the disfavored of them,
translations.16: then on the day he bequeaths to his sons what belongs to him, it is not permitted for him to give preference to the son of the beloved over the son of the disfavored who is the firstborn.
translations.17: Rather, he is obligated to make known to the people the firstborn — the son of the disfavored — so that two shares be given to him from all that belongs to him, since he is the first of his begetting; the right of the firstborn belongs to him.
translations.18: And if a man has a son who is wayward and defiant, who does not accept the command of his father and his mother, and they discipline him, yet he does not accept it from them —
translations.19: then his father and his mother shall seize him and bring him out to the elders of his town and to the gate of the judge of his place,
translations.20: and they shall say to them: 'This son of ours is wayward and defiant; he does not accept our command, and he is excessive and immoderate in what is forbidden.'
translations.21: And all the people of his town shall stone him with stones until he dies; and banish the people of wickedness from your midst — and the rest of Israel shall hear and be afraid.
translations.22: And when there is found against a person a sin whose judgment is death, and he is put to death — then hang him upon a wooden post.
translations.23: But do not leave his body on it overnight; rather, bury him in burial on that same day, for he was hanged because he fabricated falsehood against God; and do not defile thereby your land which God your Lord is giving you as an inheritance.
